address_format: hex strings with 0x and no separators; values above 2^53 do not occur but parse with BigInt for 38-bit maths

verification_values.two-source: two or more independent sources (different projects: Linux dts, HSS, MPFS HAL, MSS configurator XML, reference design, docs) give the same base
verification_values.two-source-contained: independent sources agree that the later ones lie inside the first one's range (e.g. a register inside a window)
verification_values.two-file: two or more files of the same project agree (weaker than two independent sources)
verification_values.single-source: only one source found; treat as unverified

bus_values.ddr: DDR via the segment registers (SEG0/SEG1) to U2

bus_note: bus is a classification for the simulator from the README FIC column, the DTS node and the HAL driver; the exact MSS interconnect is not in these sources

regions.name: DDR segmentation blocks SEG0/SEG1
regions.size_basis: two seg_t blocks of 64 words (mpfs-hal baremetal/polarfire-soc-bare-metal-library/src/platform/mpfs_hal/common/mss_seg.h L50); the HAL indexes SEG[0] and SEG[1] (nwc/mss_ddr.c setup_ddr_segments)
notes: SEG0 at +0x000 (CFG0..1 implemented; CFG7 bit 0 = DDRC blocker off), SEG1 at +0x100 (CFG2..5 implemented)
the HAL writes them in setup_ddr_segments() (nwc/mss_ddr.c); each offset is a signed 15-bit count of 16 MiB
mss_seg.h groups them with the MPU blocks: mss_mpu.h MSS_MPU(master) = 0x20005000 + (master << 8), so SEG0/SEG1 are slots 13/14

ddr_usage_note: how Linux uses DDR (inside the windows above); kept out of regions so regions never overlap
aliases_note: MSS peripherals also answer at +0x0800_0000 ('HI' bases in the HAL and mpfs_reg_map.h); extent not stated
ddr_segments_note: decoded from the MSS configurator XML at the HSS commit (2025 Libero design). The 2021 HSS log in logs/hss.json shows SEG1_2/SEG1_4 at physical 0x7800_0000, i.e. an older design; both are kept.

known_addresses.what: HSS copies the 748336-byte boot image here
IPI queues (6056 bytes) in the L2 scratchpad
U-Boot loads the FIT image here

boot_mode.meaning: harts start from eNVM using the reset vectors in U_MSS_BOOTCFG (Icicle Kit with the HSS in eNVM)
